Plans.Join Filter: (h.identity_key = (COALESCE(c_2.identity_key, md5((jsonb_build_array(numbered.owner_id, numbered.shipping_integration_account_id, numbered.shipping_provider, numbered.tracking_number, numbered.shipping_remote_id, numbered.sendcloud_parcel_id, numbered.label_created_at, numbered.label_cancelled_at))::text))))

Plans.Index Cond: ((owner_id = numbered.owner_id) AND (identity_key = (COALESCE(c_2.identity_key, md5((jsonb_build_array(numbered.owner_id, numbered.shipping_integration_account_id, numbered.shipping_provider, numbered.tracking_number, numbered.shipping_remote_id, numbered.sendcloud_parcel_id, numbered.label_created_at, numbered.label_cancelled_at))::text)))))

Plans.Recheck Cond: (((owner_id = numbered.owner_id) AND (order_id = numbered.id)) OR ((owner_id = numbered.owner_id) AND (order_key = CASE WHEN ((numbered.source_channel = ANY ('{amazon,shopify}'::text[])) AND (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM numbered.order_number), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)) THEN ((((numbered.source_channel || ':'::text) || COALESCE((numbered.source_integration_account_id)::text, 'legacy'::text)) || ':'::text) || TRIM(BOTH FROM numbered.order_number)) ELSE (numbered.id)::text END)))

Plans.Index Cond: ((owner_id = numbered.owner_id) AND (order_key = CASE WHEN ((numbered.source_channel = ANY ('{amazon,shopify}'::text[])) AND (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM numbered.order_number), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)) THEN ((((numbered.source_channel || ':'::text) || COALESCE((numbered.source_integration_account_id)::text, 'legacy'::text)) || ':'::text) || TRIM(BOTH FROM numbered.order_number)) ELSE (numbered.id)::text END))

Plans.Filter: (has_label AND in_cost_period AND ((shipping_cost_amount IS NULL) OR (shipping_cost_source = 'tariff_estimate'::text)))
